About the workshop

Engineering first, whatever the badge

We built our name on fast Vauxhalls: turbo conversions, forged engines, hand-made manifolds and cars that have been proven on the dyno and in competition.

That experience carries straight across to routine work. Whether your car needs a custom map, a service or a replacement key, it is handled by people who understand how it should run and who will tell you plainly what it needs.

Mapping & rolling road

Live mapping, tailored to your engine

Using our own rolling road we map each car live. Unlike a generic off-the-shelf tune, every map is written for your individual car and its specification, so the engine delivers its full potential.

We connect your car's ECU to our specialist tuning equipment and calibrate it under load, on the rollers, in controlled conditions.

Rolling road sessions

Rolling road time is also available on its own. It is an effective way to diagnose engine problems, verify performance and see exactly what your modifications have achieved.

  • Printed plot supplied after every session
  • Power and torque across the full rev range
  • Boost pressure plotted for turbocharged and supercharged engines
Because of the nature of performance applications, ECU remapping is supplied without warranty and all work is carried out at the customer's own risk. See our terms.

Ceramic coating

Ceramic coating for exhaust manifolds, exhaust components and engine parts such as cam covers and inlet manifolds. Fourteen finishes are currently available.

Swatches are indicative only. Please ask to see samples before ordering.

Powder coating

Epoxy polyester

Suited to general indoor use and applications where high UV stability is not required. Zinc-rich epoxy primers are available for phosphated or blast-cleaned steel and, with a polyester top coat, give enhanced resistance to weathering and corrosion. Low-cure coatings are available for longer production runs.

Polyester

The choice for external use where UV stability and weather resistance matter, such as automotive trim, motorcycles and architectural components. Available in a wide range of colours and effects and can be matched to your requirements.

Epoxy

For industrial and engineering applications, with excellent chemical resistance and mechanical properties. Not recommended where colour stability under UV is important. High-build coatings (500 µm) are available for anti-corrosion work.

Cromadex Extra Life

For external applications including architectural metalwork, with anti-corrosive life expectancies of up to sixteen years on powder coating systems.

    Services

    Care for your car, start to finish

    01

    Servicing

    Routine servicing to keep your car running as it should. Tell us the make, model and mileage and we will advise what is due and provide a quote before any work begins.

    Planned maintenance and wear-and-tear items dealt with properly, so that small issues are caught before they become expensive ones.

    Repairs

    Mechanical repairs and fault finding. We explain what we have found and what it will cost, and we agree the work with you first.

    04

    Key coding

    Replacement and additional keys coded to your vehicle. Call with your registration and we will confirm what is possible for your model.

    ECU mapping

    Power runs and diagnostics on the rollers: verify performance, investigate a fault under load or measure the result of an upgrade.

    Terms & conditions

    By purchasing goods from Icon Performance you agree to the terms and conditions set out below.

    Second-hand parts

    Second-hand parts are sold as used and will not be in perfect or new condition. We describe the condition of every item honestly and as accurately as possible, and items leave our premises in the condition described unless stated otherwise. Photographs are available on request.

    All mechanical working parts, such as engines, leave our premises in good working order unless stated otherwise. We cannot accept responsibility for damage or failure after goods have left our premises.

    Collection and delivery

    Collection from our business premises is preferred. Where delivery is required, we do not accept liability for loss or damage while goods are in transit.

    • Goods sent by courier are covered by standard insurance of £50. Additional cover can be purchased on request.
    • To claim for damage you must inspect the goods fully before signing for them. If they are damaged, do not sign for them. A claim cannot be made if you sign and inspect the goods afterwards.
    • Goods sent by Royal Mail and damaged in transit can be claimed for up to a value of £43. Additional cover can be purchased on request.
    • Where goods are lost in transit, a claim cannot be made until 15 days after the original date of postage.

    Refunds and returns

    • All items sent by courier or Royal Mail must be checked on receipt. If you are unhappy and have a valid reason, we can arrange a refund provided the items are returned to our company address within 5 days of receipt.
    • Special order parts cannot be returned for a refund.
    • Items bought or ordered in error by the customer may be returned, subject to a 30% restocking fee deducted from the refund.
    • Postage costs for returned items are not refunded.

    Warranty disclaimer

    Because of the nature of performance applications, parts are sold with no warranty, express or implied. The exception is parts fitted to a standard vehicle, which carry a 12-month manufacturing warranty from the date of purchase. You will need your original invoice for any claim or return.

    Dyno and ECU remapping

    Because of the nature of performance applications, ECU remapping is sold with no warranty, express or implied. Icon Performance will not be liable for any damage incurred, and all work is carried out at the customer's own risk.

    These terms and conditions may change without notice.
